title: basel iii / bank regulation / capital requirements | Regulatory Guidance | Basel III: Finalising post-crisis reforms
summary: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision published final reforms to the Basel III framework in December 2017, addressing excessive variability in risk-weighted assets (RWAs) through enhanced standardised approaches, constrained use of internal models, and a revised leverage ratio with capital floor. Implementation dates span from January 2022 through January 2027, with the output floor ramping from 50% to 72.5%.
